Class Property

java.lang.Object
model.squares.Square
model.squares.Property
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rentable
public class Property extends Square implements Rentable
Represents a purchasable property square on the board.

Players can buy properties, pay rent to owners, and upgrade them to Landmarks to increase the rent value.

    • calculateRent

      public int calculateRent(int diceRoll)
      Calculates the current rent of the property.

      If the property is upgraded to a Landmark, the rent is tripled.

      Specified by:
      calculateRent in interface Rentable
      Parameters:
      diceRoll - The dice roll value (unused for standard properties).
      Returns:
      The calculated rent amount.
